objectives.title: Throw Snowballs
objectives.description: Snowballs spawn near Heroes, Buildings, Tributes, and Regen Globes. Pick them up and throw them!

objectives.title: Collect Tributes
objectives.description: Snowy Tributes spawn rapidly. Collect them to launch collossal snowballs at enemy Structures!

objectives.title: Build Snowmen
objectives.description: Incomplete Snowmen periodically form throughout the battleground. Use snowballs to complete them, and they will join your fight!
